top_missing_areas: Dock engine: no slot resolver, no panel registry or panel move transaction, no centre tree of editor groups, no panel states, no dock-layout persistence (L0-L3, profile signature); the native host draws one static raster frame.

Tools: no 362-tool registry, no 22 families, no WORKSPACE > Tools menu, no Task Scopes, no availability on the Tool Rail; the rail is a static 19-slot raster preset whose controls answer not_implemented_yet.

Generated descriptors and manual: no build-time generator, no generated id enum, no ParamSpec from captures, no tooltip-gaps ledger, no CI gate suite, no coverage report, no write to the canonical SurrealDB manual store; UiDescriptor is a hand seed.

Tooltips and value-field time: no L0-L3 tooltip system or descriptor-driven tooltip helper, no localisation, and no TemporalState on value fields (stopwatch, keyframe navigator, auto-keyframe, expression refusal at press), no wheel scrubbing.

Storage and parallel work: SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables, SurrealKit rollout, record permissions, live queries, CRDT presence and the kernel scheduler/process ledger are absent from the asset tree (host-side); plus no shortcut policy, shortcut sets, conflict report or command palette.
notes: Judged at origin tip 87f331f9 with git grep/show only; no cargo, builds or tests were run.

The index line for many IDs points at a citing reference, not the defining clause (e.g. STU-SHL-043 at 31655, STU-SHL-190..192 at 12879, STU-SHL-221 at 207); each ID was judged against its defining clause text.

Two GUI hosts exist: the egui harness-view window (menus FILE/EDIT/VIEW/TYPE/COLOR/WORKSPACE/HELP, 25 panels; frozen by direction D1 per parity-20261111-figma-affinity-shell.json) and the native Vulkan host (SMB-GUI-FRAME-1/SPINE-1/VK-UI-PASS-1, all READY_FOR_VALIDATION): a static raster frame with all 19 menu titles, Tool Rail, Context Bar and three-group Inspect Dock where only the Layers panel works and every other control answers not_implemented_yet; native-host-only menu titles were scored PARTIAL as typed stubs.
